title: Plan42 known issues and repair guidance
summary: Plan42 guidance and executable evidence for plan42.known-issues

issues.symptom: generated entry routine was previously called as MAIN
generated shebang was treated as a command
issues.repair: invoke bash with the generated script path

issues.symptom: generated helper call may lack injected definition
issues.repair: inject only referenced preferred helpers into the preamble

rule: An issue is not closed by a static claim; close it with a reproducible target-runtime test and retained report.
